(ADR-0212's twelve OQs) and the fixer deferrals (ADR-0216: OQ-465/467/468) per the

batch-adoptable table for the operator's GATE-G7 act (`"adopt all except: <ids>"`).

get drafted amendment-log ratification text; OQ-402 is re-confirmed answered; CF-488
gets its register-side pointer to R4.15's adjudication brief. The ticket never rules —
everything below the recording act is a proposal.
